id.description: The ID of the multicast config.

igmp_last_member_query_count.description: The number of times the ION device sent IGMP queries to the last known active host on the subnet. Default value is 3 secs.

igmp_last_member_query_response_interval.description: The time interval for the ION device to respond to the IGMP query from the last known active host on the subnet. Default value is 1 secs.

igmp_querier_timeout.description: The timeout interval to wait before becoming a Querier. Default value is 380 secs.

igmp_query_interval.description: The time interval between successive IGMP queries. Default value is 125 secs.

igmp_query_response_interval.description: The maximum response time advertised in the IGMP query. Default value is 10 secs.

pim_hello_hold_time.description: The time interval which a neighbor waits for a Hello message from a sender neighbor before pruning the neighbor. Default value is 105 secs.

pim_hello_interval.description: The time interval between two PIM Hello packets. Default value is 30 secs.

pim_join_hold_interval.description: The time interval for which a receiver should wait for the next Join/Prune message from the neighbor before pruning the neighbor. Default value is 210 secs.

pim_join_prune_interval.description: The time interval between two Join/Prune messages sent to a neighbor. Default value is 60 secs.

pim_spt_threshold.description: The cut-over time from Rendezvous Point Tree (RPT) to SPT. Default value is 100 secs.

pim_triggered_hello_delay.description: The value of the Hello timer for delay between triggered Hello messages. Default value is 4 secs.

pim_ttl_threshold.description: When packets with a lower TTL than the PIM TTL threshold are discarded. Default value is 1 secs.
